## New commands
- `tiktok-shop-search-api`: search TikTok Shop products
- `tiktok-shop-product-api`: TikTok Shop product details and reviews
- `tiktok-shop-category-api`: products in a TikTok Shop category
- `tiktok-shop-store-api`: a TikTok Shop seller's store and products
- `tiktok-transcript-api`: transcript of a TikTok video
- `trustpilot-company-api`: Trustpilot company profile
- `trustpilot-reviews-api`: Trustpilot reviews for a company
- `trustpilot-search-api`: search companies on Trustpilot
- `youtube-comments-api`: comments and replies of a YouTube video, with `--sort-by top|newest`

## Changed
- `chat-gpt-chat`: new `--lat` / `--lon` flags set the user's GPS location
- `web-scraping`: `--proxy-country` accepts `IL`

## Removed
- `chat-gpt-chat --timezone`

Upgrade: `hasdata update`
